title: Diversity, Migration, and Social Cohesion
summary: Diversity, migration, belonging, participation, and social cohesion.
whyItMatters: Responsible discussion distinguishes individual experience, structural conditions, legal status, participation, and evidence.

mentalModel.title: Avoid uniform group labels
mentalModel.content: Differentiate people, institutions, policies, and statistical patterns.

mentalModel.title: Belonging has several dimensions
mentalModel.content: Consider rights, recognition, language, opportunity, and identity.

ruleBlocks.title: Use precise social terminology
ruleBlocks.content: Distinguish migration, Flucht, Integration, Inklusion, Teilhabe, and Diskriminierung.

ruleBlocks.title: Separate personal and structural explanations
ruleBlocks.content: Connect experiences to institutions without reducing either level.

ruleBlocks.title: Qualify group-level claims
ruleBlocks.content: Name population, context, source, and variation.

examples.de: Teilhabe hängt nicht nur von Sprachkenntnissen, sondern auch von institutionellen Zugängen ab.
examples.en: Participation depends not only on language skills but also on institutional access.

examples.de: Migrationserfahrungen unterscheiden sich je nach Anlass und Lebensphase.
examples.en: Migration experiences differ by reason and life stage.

examples.de: Zusammenhalt bedeutet nicht, dass alle dieselbe Identität haben müssen.
examples.en: Cohesion does not mean everyone must share one identity.

commonMistakes.wrong: Treat migrants as one homogeneous group.
Explain inequality only through individual effort.

comparisons.summary: Concessive structures express complexity without erasing tension.
Mediation supports dialogue around access and competing needs.
